title: agrostis sclerophylla
intro: Agrostis sclerophylla, commonly known as  Red Fescue Grass, is a type of grass species that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and possessing antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Agrostis sclerophylla are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory activities. Further research is needed to fully elucidate the health benefits and therapeutic actions of Red Fescue Grass.
